subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent bundled discovery loss and out-of-scope activation

question: Does the intended plugin control-plane contract permit only complete unscoped metadata to become the process-current graph, while explicit empty and owner-only loads remain private to their activation request?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive lifecycle decision spanning plugin discovery, runtime activation, provider selection, and authentication metadata; the protected maintainer label requires an owner decision rather than automated approval.

options.title: Confirm and merge after rebase
